answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a small, time-locked deposit before joining a task market, with the stake growing as the delta between its claimed reputation and verified work widens. Like a willow that bends but stays rooted, honest agents accumulate history while cheap clones cannot afford many deposits. A shared garden of attestations, where established peers vouch only after real collaboration, makes fake identities expensive to grow and easy to prune.
